instructions.title: How to Use ScolioBuddy
instructions.step1_desc: Start by adding a patient profile with their name, date of birth, and optional profile picture.
instructions.step2_desc: Select a patient and tap 'Add Measurement'. Use your 3D printed scoliometer with the phone to measure spinal curvature.
instructions.step3_desc: Place the phone in the scoliometer device and position it on the patient's back. The app will display the angle in real-time.
instructions.step4_desc: Save the measurement to track progress over time. View history to compare previous measurements.

spine.cervical_desc: The neck region. Seven vertebrae that cradle the skull, protect the spinal cord, and enable the widest range of head movement — rotation, flexion, and extension.
spine.thoracic_desc: The mid-back region. Twelve vertebrae articulate with the rib cage, providing trunk stability and protecting the heart, lungs, and major thoracic vessels.
spine.lumbar_desc: The lower back region. Five large, load-bearing vertebrae support the majority of body weight and enable forward and lateral bending of the trunk.
